statements.impact_statement: The ReDoS needs an attacker to supply the glob pattern (single-branch repeated extglobs such as +(*)). In this image the only copy is picomatch 4.0.7 at /usr/lib/node_modules/node-gyp/node_modules/picomatch, shipped by Wolfi's node-gyp 13.1.0-r2, which npm-12 depends on; Wolfi's npm bundles no copy. Its only caller is node-gyp's lib/build.js, through tinyglobby, with the fixed patterns 'build/*.sln' and 'build/*.mk', which contain no extglob, so no input reaches picomatch as a pattern. The agent in one session's container already runs arbitrary commands as the node user, so even a pattern it wrote itself would only stall its own process. check-picomatch-users.mjs fails the image build if another copy, another importer or another pattern appears. No fixed release exists (affected through 4.0.7, the latest, on 2026-11-18). Expires 2026-12-18: re-review then, and remove this statement as soon as Wolfi's node-gyp ships a fixed picomatch.
